blocks.text: will: qaror, taklif, va'da; Shall I ...? Shall we ...?

27-darsda will kelajak haqidagi fakt va taxmin uchun ishlatilganini ko'rdik. Bu darsda uning ikkinchi, so'zlashuvda juda ko'p uchraydigan vazifasi: **gapirayotgan paytda** qabul qilingan qaror, yordam taklifi va va'da. O'zbekchada bularni ham «-aman» bilan aytamiz: «Mayli, men **olaman**», «Qo'ying, men **ko'tarib beraman**», «Va'da beraman, hech kimga **aytmayman**». Bunday gaplarda deyarli doim qisqa shakl ishlatiladi: **I'll**, **we'll**. Darsning ikkinchi qismi — **shall**: Shall I ...? («-aymi?») va Shall we ...? («-aylikmi?»).

Agar qaror aynan gapirayotgan paytda tug'ilsa — **I'll** + V1. Bunday gaplar ko'pincha OK, Right, Then, In that case («unda»), I think ... so'zlari bilan boshlanadi. Bu yerda Present Simple ishlatilmaydi: kafeda «I take the soup» emas — **I'll have** the soup. Ikkilanib qaror qilganda: **I think I'll** ... («... -sam kerak», «menimcha, ... -aman»), inkori — **I don't think I'll** ....

items.text: Coffee or tea? — **I'll have** tea, please.
It's late. **I think I'll go** home.
**I don't think I'll go** out tonight.

blocks.text: Asosiy farq — qaror **qachon** qabul qilingan. Oldin, gapirishdan avval qaror qilingan bo'lsa — **going to** (→ 26-dars). Hozir, vaziyatga javoban — **will**. O'zbekchada ham farq bor: «yuvmoqchiman» (oldin o'ylaganman) va «mayli, yuvaman» (hozir qaror qildim).

rows: I**'m going to** wash the car today.
Oh, it's dirty? OK, I**'ll wash** it.

blocks.text: Taklif va va'da: I'll ..., I won't ...

Kimgadir yordam taklif qilganda ham **I'll** ishlatamiz: That bag looks heavy — I**'ll carry** it. Va'da berganda — **I'll** (qilaman) yoki **I won't** (qilmayman), ko'pincha **I promise** («va'da beraman») bilan: I**'ll pay** you back tomorrow. I **won't tell** anyone. Bu gaplarning barchasida harakat gapiruvchining **xohishiga** bog'liq — shuning uchun o'zbekchada ham «-aman / -mayman» tabiiy eshitiladi.

**Shall I** + V1? — yordam yoki xizmatni savol shaklida taklif qilish: «Xohlaysizmi, men ... qilaymi?» O'zbekchada aynan «-aymi?» shakli: Shall I open the window? — Derazani **ochaymi**? **Shall we** + V1? — birga biror ish qilishni taklif qilish: Shall we go? — **Ketaylikmi**? So'roq so'z bilan — birga qaror qabul qilish yoki maslahat so'rash: Where **shall we** go? — Qayerga **boraylik**? What **shall I** do? — Nima **qilay**? Bu shakllar Britaniyada juda tabiiy; shall faqat **I** va **we** bilan keladi.

items.text: **Shall I** make some coffee? — Yes, please.
**Shall we** go to the park? — Good idea.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: yordam taklif qilib «I open the door for you.» → **I'll open the door for you.**; «Will I open the window?» → **Shall I open the window?**; telefon hozir jiringlaganda «I'm going to answer it.» → **I'll answer it.** / **I'll get it.** (qaror hozir); «Shall you help me?» → **Will you help me?** (shall faqat I / we bilan); «I will to call you.» → **I'll call you.**

Eslab qolish: «**-aymi?**» → **Shall I ...?**; «**-aylikmi?**», «qayerga **boraylik**?» → **Shall we ...?**; «**mayli, ... -aman**» (hozir qaror, taklif, va'da) → **I'll ...**; «**-moqchiman**» (oldin qaror) → **going to**.
Amerika inglizchasida Shall I / Shall we kamroq uchraydi — u yerda ko'pincha Should I ...?, Do you want me to ...? yoki Let's ... deyiladi. Let's ... («... -aylik») — 35-darsda.

examples.title: Decisions now: **I'll** ...
examples.description: Gapirayotgan paytda qabul qilingan qaror: **I'll** + V1. Ko'pincha OK, Right, Then, In that case dan keyin. O'zbekchada: «Mayli, ... -aman», «Unda ... -aman».

sentences.text: The phone's ringing! — Don't worry, **I'll get** it.
sentences.translation: Telefon jiringlayapti! — Xavotir olmang, men **olaman**.

sentences.text: It's cold in here. — Oh, **I'll close** the window.
sentences.translation: Bu yer sovuq ekan. — Hozir derazani **yopaman**.

sentences.text: We haven't got any bread. — Right, **I'll buy** some on my way home.
sentences.translation: Nonimiz qolmabdi. — Xo'p, uyga qaytayotib **olaman**.

sentences.text: Which one do you want, the blue or the black? — **I'll take** the black one.
sentences.translation: Qaysi birini olasiz, ko'kinimi yoki qorasinimi? — **Qorasini olaman**.

sentences.text: I'm too tired to cook. — In that case, **we'll order** a pizza.
sentences.translation: Ovqat pishirishga holim yo'q. — Unda pitsa **buyurtma qilamiz**.

sentences.text: Everything looks delicious, but **I think I'll have** the lamb soup.
sentences.translation: Hammasi mazali ko'rinadi, lekin **menimcha**, qo'y go'shtli sho'rva **olaman**.

sentences.text: It's raining! — Then **I won't walk**; **I'll take** a taxi.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir yog'yapti! — Unda piyoda **bormayman**, taksi **olaman**.

sentences.text: Aziz isn't answering his phone. — Never mind, **I'll send** him a message.
sentences.translation: Aziz telefonga javob bermayapti. — Mayli, unga xabar **yozaman**.

sentences.text: Sorry, I've forgotten my wallet! — No problem, **I'll pay** this time.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, hamyonimni unutibman! — Hechqisi yo'q, bu safar men **to'layman**.

sentences.text: Did you say Madina is in hospital? **I'll visit** her tomorrow after work.
sentences.translation: Madina kasalxonada dedingizmi? Ertaga ishdan keyin uni **yo'qlab boraman**.

examples.title: Offers: **I'll** help you
examples.description: Yordam taklifi: **I'll** / **we'll** + V1 — «men ... beraman». Kimgadir qiyin bo'layotganini ko'rib, darhol taklif qilamiz.

sentences.text: That bag looks heavy — **I'll carry** it for you.
sentences.translation: Sumka og'irga o'xshaydi — men **ko'tarib beraman**.

sentences.text: You look tired. Sit down and **I'll make** you a cup of tea.
sentences.translation: Charchaganga o'xshaysiz. O'tiring, men sizga choy **damlab beraman**.

sentences.text: Is the homework difficult? **I'll help** you with it after dinner.
sentences.translation: Uy vazifasi qiyinmi? Kechki ovqatdan keyin **yordam beraman**.

sentences.text: Your car won't start? Wait a minute, **I'll call** my brother — he's a mechanic.
sentences.translation: Mashinangiz o't olmayaptimi? Bir daqiqa, akamga **qo'ng'iroq qilaman** — u mexanik.

sentences.text: Have you missed the last bus? Come with us — **we'll take** you home.
sentences.translation: Oxirgi avtobusdan qoldingizmi? Biz bilan yuring — uyingizgacha **eltib qo'yamiz**.

sentences.text: Grandma, the shop is far away. **I'll go** for you.
sentences.translation: Buvi, do'kon uzoq. **Men borib kelaman**.

sentences.text: Emma, you're busy with the baby — **I'll do** the washing-up.
sentences.translation: Emma, siz chaqaloq bilan bandsiz — idishlarni **men yuvaman**.

sentences.text: Don't take the bus. **I'll give** you a lift to the station.
sentences.translation: Avtobusga chiqmang. Sizni vokzalgacha **olib borib qo'yaman**.

sentences.text: Are you lost? **I'll show** you the way to the museum.
sentences.translation: Adashib qoldingizmi? Muzeyga yo'lni **ko'rsatib qo'yaman**.

sentences.text: If you're busy on Saturday, **I'll look** after the children.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni band bo'lsangiz, bolalarga **men qarab turaman**.

examples.title: Promises: **I'll** ..., **I won't** ...
examples.description: Va'da: **I'll** + V1 / **I won't** + V1, ko'pincha I promise bilan. O'zbekchada: «albatta ... -aman», «va'da beraman, ... -mayman».

sentences.text: Thank you for the money. **I'll pay** you back on Friday.
sentences.translation: Pul uchun rahmat. Juma kuni **qaytarib beraman**.

sentences.text: **I won't tell** anyone about it, I promise.
sentences.translation: Bu haqda hech kimga **aytmayman**, va'da beraman.

sentences.text: Don't worry, Mum. **I'll phone** you as soon as I arrive.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, oyi. Yetib borishim bilan sizga **qo'ng'iroq qilaman**.

sentences.text: Sorry I was late again. It **won't happen** again.
sentences.translation: Yana kechikkanim uchun uzr. Boshqa **takrorlanmaydi**.

sentences.text: I promise **I'll study** harder next term.
sentences.translation: Va'da beraman, kelasi chorakda qattiqroq **o'qiyman**.

sentences.text: Your secret is safe with me — **I won't say** a word.
sentences.translation: Siringiz menda saqlanadi — hech kimga **og'iz ochmayman**.

sentences.text: Thanks for lending me your camera. **I'll take** good care of it.
sentences.translation: Kamerangizni berib turganingiz uchun rahmat. Unga yaxshi **qarayman**.

sentences.text: Bekzod promised his wife, "**I'll be** home by eight."
sentences.translation: Bekzod xotiniga «Sakkizgacha uyda **bo'laman**» deb va'da berdi.

sentences.text: Next time **I won't forget** your birthday, I promise!
sentences.translation: Keyingi safar tug'ilgan kuningizni **unutmayman**, va'da beraman!

sentences.text: We**'ll write** to you every week, and we**'ll send** lots of photos.
sentences.translation: Sizga har hafta **xat yozamiz** va ko'p surat **yuboramiz**.

examples.title: **Shall I** ...? — offering to help
examples.description: Yordam taklifini savol shaklida berish: **Shall I** + V1? O'zbekchada: «-aymi?» — Derazani **ochaymi**? Javob: Yes, please. / No, thanks.

sentences.text: It's hot in here. **Shall I open** the window? — Yes, please.
sentences.translation: Bu yer issiq. Derazani **ochaymi**? — Ha, iltimos.

sentences.text: **Shall I carry** your suitcase upstairs?
sentences.translation: Chamadoningizni yuqoriga **olib chiqaymi**?

sentences.text: Mum, **shall I set** the table for dinner?
sentences.translation: Oyi, kechki ovqatga dasturxon **yozaymi**?

sentences.text: The music is a bit loud — **shall I turn** it down?
sentences.translation: Musiqa biroz baland — **pasaytiraymi**?

sentences.text: Your glass is empty. **Shall I get** you some more juice?
sentences.translation: Stakaningiz bo'sh. Yana sharbat **olib kelaymi**?

sentences.text: **Shall I call** a taxi for you, or are you walking?
sentences.translation: Sizga taksi **chaqiraymi** yoki piyoda ketasizmi?

sentences.text: Dad, **shall I wash** the car this afternoon? — Yes, thank you!
sentences.translation: Dada, tushdan keyin mashinani **yuvaymi**? — Ha, rahmat!

sentences.text: The room is getting dark. **Shall I put** the lights on?
sentences.translation: Xona qorong'ilashyapti. Chiroqlarni **yoqaymi**?

sentences.text: Madina, **shall I help** you with the cooking?
sentences.translation: Madina, ovqat pishirishga **yordamlashaymi**?

sentences.text: I don't know what to wear tomorrow. — **Shall I lend** you my blue dress?
sentences.translation: Ertaga nima kiyishni bilmayman. — Ko'k ko'ylagimni **berib turaymi**?

examples.title: **Shall we** ...? **Where shall we** go?
examples.description: Birga biror ish qilishni taklif: **Shall we** + V1? Birga qaror qabul qilish: Where / What / What time **shall we** ...? O'zbekchada: «-aylikmi?», «qayerga boraylik?».

sentences.text: It's a lovely evening. **Shall we go** for a walk?
sentences.translation: Ajoyib oqshom. **Sayr qilaylikmi**?

sentences.text: **Shall we take** a taxi? It's raining.
sentences.translation: Taksi **olaylikmi**? Yomg'ir yog'yapti.

sentences.text: Where **shall we** have lunch today? — How about that new café?
sentences.translation: Bugun qayerda **tushlik qilaylik**? — Anavi yangi kafe-chi?

sentences.text: What time **shall we** meet tomorrow? — Is ten o'clock OK?
sentences.translation: Ertaga soat nechada **uchrashaylik**? — Soat o'n bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: What **shall we** buy Dilnoza for her birthday?
sentences.translation: Dilnozaga tug'ilgan kuniga nima **sovg'a qilaylik**?

sentences.text: We're late already. **Shall we** start without Tom?
sentences.translation: Kech qoldik. Tomsiz **boshlayveraylikmi**?

sentences.text: **Shall we** invite James and Sarah to dinner on Saturday?
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni Jeyms bilan Sarani kechki ovqatga **taklif qilaylikmi**?

sentences.text: Which film **shall we** watch tonight — the comedy or the thriller?
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun qaysi filmni **ko'raylik** — komediyanimi yoki trillernimi?

sentences.text: It's your turn to choose. Where **shall we** go on holiday this year?
sentences.translation: Tanlash navbati sizda. Bu yil ta'tilga qayerga **boraylik**?

sentences.text: How **shall we** get to Khiva — by train or by plane?
sentences.translation: Xivaga qanday **boraylik** — poyezddami yoki samolyotdami?

examples.title: **going to** (decided before) or **I'll** (decided now)?
examples.description: Qaror qachon qabul qilingan? Oldin — **going to** («-moqchiman»). Hozir, vaziyatga javoban — **will** («mayli, ... -aman»).

sentences.text: Why have you got a ladder? — **I'm going to** clean the windows.
sentences.translation: Nega narvon olib yuribsiz? — Derazalarni **tozalamoqchiman**.

sentences.text: The windows are dirty. — Oh, you're right. **I'll clean** them.
sentences.translation: Derazalar iflos. — Ha, to'g'ri aytasiz. **Tozalayman**.

sentences.text: Aziz has already decided: he**'s going to** study in Germany.
sentences.translation: Aziz allaqachon qaror qildi: Germaniyada **o'qimoqchi**.

sentences.text: Germany or Korea? Let me think... OK, **I'll choose** Korea.
sentences.translation: Germaniyami yoki Koreyami? O'ylab ko'ray... Mayli, Koreyani **tanlayman**.

sentences.text: We**'re going to** have a barbecue on Sunday — we bought the meat yesterday.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kuni kabob **qilmoqchimiz** — go'shtni kecha olib qo'ydik.

sentences.text: A barbecue? Great, **I'll bring** some salads!
sentences.translation: Kabobmi? Zo'r, men salat **olib kelaman**!

sentences.text: Sarah **is going to** paint her bedroom — she's chosen the colour.
sentences.translation: Sara yotoqxonasini **bo'yamoqchi** — rangini ham tanlab qo'ydi.

sentences.text: Your bedroom? **I'll help** you, Sarah — I love painting!
sentences.translation: Yotoqxonangiznimi? Men **yordam beraman**, Sara — bo'yashni yaxshi ko'raman!

sentences.text: Have you decided about the car? — Yes, **I'm going to** sell it.
sentences.translation: Mashina haqida qaror qildingizmi? — Ha, uni **sotmoqchiman**.

sentences.text: Sell it? Then **I'll buy** it — I need a car for my new job!
sentences.translation: Sotasizmi? Unda **men sotib olaman** — yangi ishim uchun mashina kerak!

examples.title: Dialogue: guests are coming!
examples.description: Dialog: mehmonlar kelishidan oldin er-xotin ishlarni taqsimlaydi. Shall I ...? / Shall we ...? — taklif; I'll ... — hozir qabul qilingan qaror va va'da.

sentences.text: — Bekzod, our guests are coming at seven. **Shall we** make a plan?
sentences.translation: — Bekzod, mehmonlarimiz soat yettida keladi. Reja **tuzib olaylikmi**?

sentences.text: — Good idea. **I'll go** to the market and buy the meat.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr. Men bozorga **borib**, go'sht **olib kelaman**.

sentences.text: — Great. And **shall I** make the salads, or **shall we** order them?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Salatlarni men **qilaymi** yoki buyurtma **beraylikmi**?

sentences.text: — You make the best salads in Tashkent! **I won't eat** anyone else's.
sentences.translation: — Siz Toshkentdagi eng zo'r salatlarni qilasiz! Boshqanikini **yemayman**.

sentences.text: — Ha-ha! OK, **I'll make** them. What about dessert?
sentences.translation: — Ha-ha! Mayli, o'zim **qilaman**. Shirinlik-chi?

sentences.text: — **I'll pick** up a cake from that bakery near the metro.
sentences.translation: — Metro yonidagi novvoyxonadan tort **olib kelaman**.

sentences.text: — Perfect. And who's cleaning the flat? **Shall we** do it together?
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib. Kvartirani kim yig'ishtiradi? Birga **qilaylikmi**?

sentences.text: — Fine, but first **I'll take** the children to my mother's.
sentences.translation: — Mayli, lekin avval bolalarni onamnikiga **olib borib qo'yaman**.

sentences.text: — Don't be late! The guests **will be** here at seven sharp.
sentences.translation: — Kechikmang! Mehmonlar roppa-rosa soat yettida shu yerda **bo'lishadi**.

sentences.text: — **I won't be** late, I promise. **I'll be** back by five.
sentences.translation: — **Kechikmayman**, va'da beraman. Soat beshgacha **qaytaman**.

examples.title: Mixed practice: all the ways to talk about the future
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash (25–28-darslar): reja — Present Continuous, jadval — Present Simple, niyat va dalil — going to, fikr, qaror, taklif va va'da — will, taklif savoli — Shall I / Shall we.

sentences.text: **I'm meeting** Aziz at six, and our film **starts** at half past seven.
sentences.translation: Soat oltida Aziz bilan **uchrashaman**, filmimiz yetti yarimda **boshlanadi**.

sentences.text: Those clouds are very dark — **it's going to** snow tonight.
sentences.translation: Bulutlar juda qora — bugun kechasi qor **yog'adiganga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: **Shall I** bring my guitar to the party? — Yes, please! **We'll** all **sing**.
sentences.translation: Ziyofatga gitaramni **olib boraymi**? — Ha, albatta! Hammamiz **qo'shiq aytamiz**.

sentences.text: **I think** Madina **will be** a great teacher — she's so patient.
sentences.translation: **Menimcha**, Madina ajoyib o'qituvchi **bo'ladi** — u juda sabrli.

sentences.text: My cousin **is going to** open a café in Bukhara next year.
sentences.translation: Amakivachcham kelasi yili Buxoroda kafe **ochmoqchi**.

sentences.text: The doorbell! — Stay there, **I'll answer** it.
sentences.translation: Eshik qo'ng'irog'i! — Joyingizdan turmang, men **ochaman**.

sentences.text: What time **does** the museum **close** on Saturdays?
sentences.translation: Shanba kunlari muzey soat nechada **yopiladi**?

sentences.text: We **aren't going** anywhere at the weekend; my parents **are visiting** us.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari hech qayerga **ketmaymiz** — ota-onam bizni **ko'rgani kelishyapti**.

sentences.text: **I won't forget** to water your plants while you're away, I promise.
sentences.translation: Siz yo'qligingizda gullaringizga suv quyishni **unutmayman**, va'da beraman.

sentences.text: Tomorrow is Emma's last day at work. **Shall we** buy her some flowers?
sentences.translation: Ertaga Emmaning oxirgi ish kuni. Unga gul **olaylikmi**?
